In view of this, the performance they put up was little short of marvellous, and all seven of them are to be heartily congratulated on their fine sporting spirit in carrying through the contest and on providing such a close and exciting match. The 100 Yards was won by J.

Jack Wigley, the T.V.H. sprinter, was the outstanding runner and he beat Tommy Jover in both the 100 and 220 Yards. We were more than pleased to see Len Marchant and Frankie Webb at the meeting, and the former ran in ezcellent style in the 880 Yards, only to lose the race in the last few yards to G.
